name: convert-documents-to-markdown
title_zh: 喂它 .docx 还你干净 Markdown
tagline_zh: PDF、Word、PPT、Excel、EPUB 全都能读，但只输出一种格式：GitHub 风味 Markdown。
tagline_en: PDF, Word, PPT, Excel, EPUB all in—but only one output: GitHub-flavored Markdown. Tables, lists, headings stay.
desc_en: Convert Word (.doc, .docx), PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx), Excel (.xls, .xlsx), OpenDocument (.odt, .ods, .odp), RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files to GitHub-Flavored Markdown. Use when a task needs the contents of an office document, spreadsheet, presentation, ebook, or PDF you cannot read directly.
why_zh: 别的转换器给你 HTML 或乱糟糟的纯文本，它直接产出结构化 Markdown。
why_en: Others hand you HTML or messy plain text; this one outputs structured Markdown directly, even attempts OCR on scanned PDFs—so.
limit_zh: 只认本地文件路径，不接 URL；加密或带密码的 Office 文档直接失败；复杂排版（多栏。
limit_en: Local file paths only, no URLs; password-protected Office files fail outright; complex layouts (multi-column, overlapping text boxes) flatten to.
title_en: Feed it .docx, get clean Markdown—even text buried in .ppt
